AiImportDefaultsNotice: These are the defaults. Nothing has been saved for this space yet; change anything and press Save.
AiImportPlaceholders: Amounts in step text (scales with servings)
AiImportPromptHelp: Appended to the built-in rules. The rules that prevent invented amounts and missing units always stay in force.
AiImportPromptPlaceholder: e.g. Keep it short, no filler words. Do not mention the origin of the dish.
AiImportExplainPlaceholders: Writes an ingredient as a template reference in the step, e.g. "450 Gramm Weizenmehl". When you change the servings, the amount follows.
AiImportExplainImages: Collects the photos from the imported page so you can pick one in the editor.
AiImportExplainStepTitles: Moves a heading the AI wrote into the text back into the step title field. Without it, steps can end up untitled.
AiImportTestUrlHint: Try this URL with your prompt. Nothing is saved.
AiImportUnknownFoods: foods are not in your library yet
